title: Starbucks 2021 Holiday Reusable Red Cup Ribbon Plastic Tumbler 16oz Grande
descriptionText:
No lid, no straw

Get your hands on the limited edition Starbucks 2021 Holiday Reusable Red Cup Ribbon Plastic Tumbler. This 16oz Grande cup is perfect for your coffee and tea fix. The cup features a beautiful red color with ribbon detailing and is made of durable plastic. It is perfect for collectors and coffee lovers alike. The cup is an original Starbucks product and is not modified. California Prop 65 Warning does not apply to this item. Add this unique cup to your collection today!
